tasks.subject: Task 1: PWA shell (manifest + cache-first SW + persist/install)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Installable, offline-capable PWA shell that precaches its core files and persists storage.

**Files:** app/index.html, app/app.js, app/sw.js, app/manifest.webmanifest, app/icons/icon-{192,512}.png

**Verify:** serve `python -m http.server 8001 -d app`; SW activates; DevTools Offline reload loads shell; Lighthouse Installable passes.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/index.html","app/app.js","app/sw.js","app/manifest.webmanifest","app/icons/icon-192.png","app/icons/icon-512.png"], "verifyCommand": "python -m http.server 8001 -d app (manual: SW activates, offline reload, Lighthouse Installable)", "acceptanceCriteria": ["shell loads w/ controls + empty #map, no console errors","cache-first SW precaches core list","first run persist() + install hint","offline reload loads shell","Lighthouse Installable passes"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Map core — both maps + toggle (vendored Leaflet)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Render 2016 raster (rotated WebP overlay) + 2025 vector (SVG overlay) with a toggle, all libs/assets vendored offline.

**Files:** app/vendor/{leaflet.js,leaflet.css,Leaflet.ImageOverlay.Rotated.js}, app/map2016.webp, app/overlay2016.json, app/page2.svg, app/page2_overlay.json, app/index.html, app/app.js, app/sw.js, tools/check_app_assets.py

**Verify:** `python tools/check_app_assets.py` OK; serve, DevTools Offline reload → both maps render + toggle works.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/vendor/","app/map2016.webp","app/overlay2016.json","app/page2.svg","app/page2_overlay.json","app/index.html","app/app.js","app/sw.js","tools/check_app_assets.py"], "verifyCommand": "python tools/check_app_assets.py ; serve + DevTools Offline reload", "acceptanceCriteria": ["2016 webp rotated overlay crisp","2025 svg overlay","2016/2025 toggle + fitBounds","loads offline (vendored+precached)","check_app_assets passes"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: GPS module — live dot + accuracy ring + recenter
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Track live position with a blue dot + accuracy ring and a recenter button.

**Files:** app/index.html (recenter button), app/app.js (watchPosition + recenter)

**Verify:** DevTools Sensors set location → dot + ring appear, recenter enables/centers; real-phone confirms tracking.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/index.html","app/app.js"], "verifyCommand": "DevTools Sensors location; real-phone tracking", "acceptanceCriteria": ["watchPosition blue dot + accuracy circle update","recenter centers on last fix (disabled until first)","denied/unavailable -> non-blocking msg, map usable"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: GPX route loader
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Load a .gpx from device storage and draw it as a route polyline.

**Files:** app/index.html (file input), app/app.js (parseGpxLatLngs ported from viewer/app.js)

**Verify:** load drive-in GPX → red polyline + start/end markers, fits bounds; empty GPX → message.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/index.html","app/app.js"], "verifyCommand": "load GPX in browser", "acceptanceCriteria": ["GPX -> red polyline + start/end markers + fit bounds","empty GPX -> no-coordinates message","works offline (client-side parse)"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Mini-legend (reimplemented, collapsible)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Compact flowable HTML/CSS legend in the controls pane, collapsible, faithful to the sheets (symbology in output/_leg_*.png).

**Files:** app/index.html (legend markup + CSS), app/app.js (collapse toggle)

**Verify:** narrow to phone width; expand/collapse; swatches match output/_leg_zoom.png + _leg_left.png.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/index.html","app/app.js"], "verifyCommand": "narrow viewport; compare to output/_leg_*.png", "acceptanceCriteria": ["difficulty (green/blue/black) + roads + special-trail bands + key symbols","collapses/expands + reflows on <=400px"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Deploy — build assets + GitHub Pages (end-to-end)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Publish app/ via GitHub Pages (Actions) from the public repo and confirm the installed PWA works offline on a real phone.

> **USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** Close only after every acceptanceCriteria item is re-validated independently, with output captured.

**Files:** .github/workflows/pages.yml, README.md

**Verify:** curl -I the Pages URL -> 200; then real-phone airplane-mode walkthrough.

```json:metadata
{"files": [".github/workflows/pages.yml","README.md","app/"], "verifyCommand": "curl -I https://verstandinvictus.github.io/winom-frazier-geopdf/ ; real-phone airplane-mode walkthrough", "acceptanceCriteria": ["check_app_assets passes + webp ~3-5MB","repo public + Pages (Actions) serves app/ over HTTPS 200","real-phone airplane-mode: map+toggle+GPX+live GPS dot all work","README setup documented"], "userGate": true, "tags": ["user-gate"]}
```
